subject: Upcoming Liquidity Requirement – Hong Kong Property Purchase
body:
Dear Ms Adeyemi-Lim,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to follow up regarding the anticipated requirement of USD 3,600,000 from April 2027 in connection with your planned property purchase in Hong Kong.

To ensure we plan appropriately ahead of this date, I would welcome the opportunity to meet with you at your convenience to discuss the timing and preparation of your accounts in relation to this requirement.

Please let me know a few dates that would suit you, and I will arrange the meeting accordingly.

With kind regards,

[Relationship Manager Name]
Julius Baer
